description:
Our Mission

Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

About the Role

You will own inference performance and correctness for pre-training evaluations. You will be bridging between our training framework to our inference framework. Your work will span model implementations, GPU execution, distributed serving, and the lifecycle of inference workers, from making a checkpoint ready to serve through completing an evaluation.

Working closely with researchers and engineers in pre-training and post-training, you will track ongoing research work, implement them efficiently, and establish the validation needed to deploy them confidently. You will help turn workload-specific tuning and one-off debugging into reliable systems that keep pace with new models, hardware, and research needs.

  • Establish parity between ongoing ML research modeling in training framework and inference framework via defining numerical acceptance criteria based on activations, logits, and downstream evaluation results.

  • Optimize inference for pre-training by profiling CPU and GPU execution, memory use, communication, and scheduling to understand where the time and resource go. Improve the components that limit real evaluation workloads, and validate that changes improve throughput or cost while preserving correctness.

  • Improve autoscaling and fleet efficiency by determining which signals best capture demand and available serving capacity, such as queued work, token processing, cache pressure, and server health.

About You

  • You have a track record of improving performance or reliability in complex distributed systems and inference infrastructure .

  • You understand how CPU execution, GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, and interconnects shape performance. You can reason quantitatively about compute limits, memory bandwidth, communication overhead, and the tradeoffs between different forms of parallelism.

  • You understand inference, including prefill and decode, batching, attention, KV-cache management, and distributed model execution, and can connect those concepts to observed system behavior.

  • You approach optimization through careful measurement: form a hypothesis, design a useful experiment, identify the bottleneck, and demonstrate the effect of the change.

  • You bring rigor to correctness. You can distinguish implementation errors, expected numerical differences, and experimental noise, and design validation that catches meaningful regressions.

  • You take ownership of ambiguous technical problems by discovering and locating issues independently, communicate findings clearly, and work effectively with researchers and engineers to carry improvements into regular use.

What We Offer:

We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models.

We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported.

  • Top-tier compensation: Salary and equity structured to recognize and retain our talent globally.

  • Stock options: Everyone who joins and contributes to Reflection's success gets to share in the upside through stock options.

  • Health & wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life, with an annual wellness allowance.

  • Meals: Lunch and dinner are provided in the office daily.

  • Life & family: 22 weeks paid parental leave for all new birthing and non-birthing parents, including adoptive and surrogate journeys.

  • Vacation days: Unlimited paid time off in the U.S. and 30 days in the U.K.

  • Sponsorship support: We sponsor visas to help exceptional talent join our team and support long-term immigration pathways where applicable.

  • Team building: We have regular off-sites, happy hours, and team celebrations.

Export Control Notice: This position may require access to technology or source code subject to the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Any offer of employment for this role may be conditioned on the Company's ability to provide the candidate with access to such technology or source code in compliance with applicable U.S. export control laws, which may require the Company to seek government authorization.
